## Domain entities (`lib/features/settings/domain/entities/`)

### `AggregateBucket`
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | `DateTime` | Parsed from the backend's `YYYY-MM-DD` string, date-only (no time component kept). |
| `count` | `int` | ≥ 0. |
| `sources` | `DashboardSourceCounts` | `{manual, audio, photo, chat}`, each `int` ≥ 0 — carried for completeness; this unit's chart only ever renders `count` (no per-source stacking/legend in scope). |

### `DashboardTotals`
`{count: int, sources: DashboardSourceCounts}` — the account-wide total for the requested period.

### `DashboardAggregate`
`{buckets: List<AggregateBucket>, totals: DashboardTotals}`. One pure extension method:
- `List<int> tenBars({DateTime? today})` → `research.md R2`'s `tenBars` function, `today` defaulting to

### `DashboardNarrative`
`{text: String, generatedAt: DateTime}` — `generatedAt` is parsed but never displayed (spec.md: the
narrative's own content/quality is out of scope); kept only because the response always carries it and
dropping a required field silently would be a worse modeling choice than keeping it unused.

### `AccountProfile`
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `displayName` | `String` | 1–80 chars once set; the screen's single source of truth for both the name field and avatar initials. |
| `email` | `String` | Read-only in this unit (FR-009); sourced from `SessionRepository`'s already-resolved `Account.email`, never from a Settings-owned call. |

Static/instance helpers (research.md R13):
- `static String defaultDisplayNameFromEmail(String email)` — splits the email's local part on `._-`,
  title-cases each word, joins with a space (`"wagner.duarte@x.com"` → `"Wagner Duarte"`); `email` itself if
  the local part is empty.
- `String get initials` — 1–2 uppercase letters from `displayName`'s whitespace-split words (first letter of
  the first word, plus first letter of the second word if one exists); `"?"` if `displayName` is empty.
- `static bool isValidDisplayName(String value)` — `value.trim().isNotEmpty && value.trim().length <= 80`
  (FR-011) — pure, used by both the bloc (to block a bad submit client-side) and its own unit test.

## Repository interfaces (`lib/features/settings/domain/repositories/`)

### `DashboardRepository`
```dart
Future<Either<Failure, DashboardAggregate>> fetchAggregate();
Future<Either<Failure, DashboardNarrative>> fetchNarrative();
```
Both internally fixed to `period=all` (no parameter exposed, FR-002). Both retry exactly once via
`SessionRepository.refresh()` on `AuthExpiredFailure` (same shape as `EntriesRepositoryImpl`); a second
`AuthExpiredFailure` after that retry is returned as-is and triggers `SettingsBloc.reauthRequired`.

### `AccountProfileRepository`
```dart
Future<String?> readCachedDisplayName();                     // local-only, no network
Future<Either<Failure, String>> updateDisplayName(String name); // PATCH account-settings-update
Future<void> clearCachedDisplayName();                         // used by both Sair and Apagar conta
```
`updateDisplayName` persists the confirmed name into `AccountProfileLocalCache` before returning `Right` —
the local cache and "last confirmed backend value" are the same write, never two.

### `AccountDeletionRepository`
```dart
Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> deleteAccount(); // DELETE /account, confirmation: "DELETE" supplied internally
```

### Reused, unmodified, from other features (research.md R6/R8/R9)
- `BiometricsPreferenceRepository.save(bool)` (`vault/domain/`) — the network write.
- `VaultRepository.isBiometricPreferenceEnabled()` / `.setBiometricPreferenceLocally(bool)` /
  `.checkBiometricCapability()` / `.hasPinConfigured()` (`vault/domain/`) — local mirror + capability +
  post-logout destination.
- `AuthRepository.logout()` (`auth/domain/`, new method on an existing interface) — `POST /auth/logout`.
- `SessionRepository.clear()` (`session/domain/`) — wipes `SecureTokenStorage`.
- `EntriesRepository.clearLocalData()` / `ChatRepository.clearLocalData()` (new methods on existing
  interfaces) — wipe each feature's in-memory mirror + call its local cache's new `clear()`.

## Use cases (`lib/features/settings/domain/usecases/`)

### `SaveSettingsBiometricPreferenceUseCase`
`Future<Either<Failure, void>> call(bool enabled)` — research.md R6's await-then-mirror-or-revert sequence.
Depends on `BiometricsPreferenceRepository` + `VaultRepository` (both `vault/domain/`).

No other usecase classes are introduced — `DashboardRepository`/`AccountProfileRepository`/
`AccountDeletionRepository`'s methods are each already a single, narrow operation (the same "repository method
is usecase-shaped" choice `ExportBloc`/`ChatBloc` already make for most of their own calls); `SettingsBloc`
calls them directly.

## `SettingsState` (`lib/features/settings/presentation/bloc/settings_state.dart`, research.md R4)

One `Equatable` class, `copyWith` with the `RecordsLoaded`-style `_unset` sentinel for every nullable field
that must be explicitly clearable to `null`.

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dashboardStatus` | `DashboardStatus` enum: `loading, loaded, loadFailure` | `loading` | |
| `aggregate` | `DashboardAggregate?` | `null` | Set once `dashboardStatus == loaded`. |
| `dashboardFailure` | `Failure?` | `null` | Set once `dashboardStatus == loadFailure`; retryable per FR-007. |
| `narrativeStatus` | `NarrativeStatus` enum: `notRequested, loading, loaded, unavailable` | `notRequested` | `notRequested` for the zero/one-entry cases (FR-003/004); never transitions once there (FR-006's distinctness). |
| `narrativeText` | `String?` | `null` | Set once `narrativeStatus == loaded`. |
| `displayName` | `String` | `''` (loading placeholder) | The name actually shown — cached/edited value or the email-derived default once email is known. |
| `email` | `String` | `''` | From `SessionRepository`; read-only display. |
| `nameEditStatus` | `NameEditStatus` enum: `viewing, editing, saving, error` | `viewing` | |
| `nameDraft` | `String` | `''` | The in-progress edit field's text — preserved across a failed save (FR-012). |
| `nameEditFailureMessage` | `String?` | `null` | Validation (FR-011) or network (FR-012) message; cleared on re-entering edit mode. |
| `biometricToggleVisible` | `bool` | `false` | `true` only when `VaultRepository.checkBiometricCapability() == available` (FR-013's "hidden entirely" rule). |
| `biometricEnabled` | `bool` | `false` | Mirrors `VaultRepository.isBiometricPreferenceEnabled()` until a confirmed toggle changes it. |
| `biometricSaving` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `biometricFailureMessage` | `String?` | `null` | Set on a reverted save (FR-014); cleared on the next toggle attempt. |
| `isSigningOut` | `bool` | `false` | FR-022 guard. |
| `isDeletingAccount` | `bool` | `false` | FR-022 guard. |
| `deleteDialogOpen` | `bool` | `false` | Presentation-only flag the page uses to show/hide the confirmation dialog (FR-017/FR-021) — no backend call is implied by this alone. |
| `deleteFailureMessage` | `String?` | `null` | FR-020; shown inside the still-open dialog. |
| `signedOutDestination` | `SettingsDestination?` (`vault`/`login`) | `null` | A one-shot signal (research.md R10) — `SettingsPage`'s `BlocListener` navigates on any non-null value and the bloc never re-emits it after. |
| `accountDeletedDestination` | `SettingsDestination?` | `null` | Same shape as above, for the deletion success path — kept as a separate field from `signedOutDestination` only so a listener can tell which flow completed if ever needed for analytics/logging; both drive identical navigation. |

## Widgets and the tokens they consume (RNF08 — zero hardcoded values)

| Widget | New tokens used | Reused tokens |
|---|---|---|
| `ProfileHeader` (avatar + name + email) | `sizeAvatarSettings` (52) | `colorPrimary`, `colorOnPrimary`, `textTitleSm`, `textBodyMd`, `colorTextSecondary`, `spacingLg/Md` |
| `DashboardBarChart` (populated/one-bar states) | `sizeChartBarMaxHeight`, `sizeChartBarWidth`, `sizeChartBarGap` | `colorAccent` (ochre bars) |
| `DashboardEmptyState` (zero entries) | `colorChartPlaceholder` | `textBodyMd`, `colorTextSecondary` |
| `NarrativeView` (loaded / unavailable) | — | `textBodyMd`, `colorTextSecondary`, `colorError` |
| `BiometricToggleRow` | — | `textBodyLg`, `Switch` theme colors already derived from `AppTheme.theme` |
| `DeleteAccountDialog` | — | `colorError`, `textTitleLg`, `textBodyMd`, `radiusLg`, `elevation2` (same "confirmation dialog" component the session-expired overlay already uses) |

New `DesignTokens` additions (research.md R14), appended to the existing Sizes/Colors sections, values only:
`sizeAvatarSettings = 52`, `sizeChartBarMaxHeight = 120`, `sizeChartBarWidth = 20`, `sizeChartBarGap = 6`,
`colorChartPlaceholder = Color(0xFFE1DACB)` (= `colorBorder`'s own value, reused under a semantically distinct
name since the token panel's "placeholder chart icon" use is conceptually different from "dividers, borders"
even though the color is the same).

1	# Research: P-RF09 — Temporal summaries / dashboard
2	
3	Phase 0 output. Each item is a technical-judgment decision this plan must make beyond what spec.md's own FRs/
4	Clarifications/Assumptions already resolve (Constitution Principle I: "where these documents are silent,
5	implementers MUST make a reasonable technical decision rather than block on clarification"). None of these
6	reopen a resolved Clarification; each builds directly on spec.md's own wording.
7	
8	## R1 — Dashboard data flow is two independent repository calls, gated by `totals.count`
9	
10	`DashboardRepository.fetchAggregate()` and `fetchNarrative()` are two separate methods, called separately by
11	`SettingsBloc`, never composed into one. The aggregate call always fires on `SettingsOpened`/retry (FR-001,
12	FR-008). The narrative call fires only after the aggregate succeeds **and** `aggregate.totals.count >= 2`
13	(FR-003/FR-004/FR-005) — the bloc inspects the already-resolved aggregate's own total, never a second network
14	round-trip to "find out" the count. Both calls send the single fixed query parameter `period=all` (spec.md
15	Assumption "Dashboard period") — no period parameter is ever user-controlled in this unit.
16	
17	## R2 — Ten-bar bucketing is a pure, total function over `(buckets, today)`
18	
19	Spec.md's Clarification/Assumption fixes the algorithm in words ("divide the account's full date range — date
20	of the first entry through today — into ten roughly-equal time slices and sum the per-date counts falling
21	within each slice"); this unit only has to fix the exact integer arithmetic so the function is deterministic
22	and testable:
23	
24	```
25	List<int> tenBars(List<AggregateBucket> buckets, DateTime today) {
26	  if (buckets.isEmpty) return List.filled(10, 0);
27	  final start = buckets.map((b) => b.date).reduce((a, b) => a.isBefore(b) ? a : b);
28	  final totalDaySpan = today.difference(start).inDays; // >= 0; both date-only (UTC midnight)
29	  final bars = List.filled(10, 0);
30	  if (totalDaySpan == 0) {
31	    // Every entry happened "today" relative to the account's own first entry
32	    // (e.g. 2 entries created minutes apart) — a single-day range cannot be
33	    // divided into 10 meaningful slices, so the whole total lands in the
34	    // last bar rather than every bar collapsing onto index 0.
35	    bars[9] = buckets.fold(0, (sum, b) => sum + b.count);
36	    return bars;
37	  }
38	  for (final bucket in buckets) {
39	    final daysSinceStart = bucket.date.difference(start).inDays;
40	    final index = (daysSinceStart * 10) ~/ (totalDaySpan + 1);
41	    bars[index.clamp(0, 9)] += bucket.count;
42	  }
43	  return bars;
44	}
45	```
46	`totalDaySpan + 1` (not `totalDaySpan`) is the slice divisor so the very last day (`daysSinceStart ==
47	totalDaySpan`) still lands inside bar index 9, not spilling past it. This function is pure (no `DateTime.now()`
48	inside it — the caller passes `today`), lives in `domain/`, and is the one piece of this unit's logic RNF07
49	most needs to hit ≥80% on, mirroring `DateRangeFilter`/`SyncBadgeState`'s existing pure-derivation shape.
50	
51	## R3 — No new charting dependency
52	
53	The chart is always exactly 10 bars with no interaction (no tooltip, no zoom, no legend) — a `Row` of 10
54	`Container`s whose heights are `count / maxBarCount * DesignTokens.sizeChartBarMaxHeight` (clamped to a
55	minimum visible sliver for a non-zero, sub-pixel bar) already renders this losslessly with widgets the app
56	already depends on. Adding `fl_chart`/`syncfusion_flutter_charts`/etc. for 10 static bars would be the first
57	charting dependency in the app for a shape plain `Flutter` already draws — rejected (Complexity Tracking).
58	Principle II's "chart package" being a free/open choice means "free to add one if needed," not "must add one."
59	
60	## R4 — `SettingsState` is one flat composite state, not a sealed per-mode hierarchy
61	
62	Unlike `VaultBloc` (a strictly sequential state machine — PIN setup, then biometric prompt, then unlock) or
63	`ExportBloc` (one sheet, one job, mutually exclusive terminal states), Settings' four concerns — dashboard,
64	narrative, profile/name-edit, biometric toggle, sign-out, account-deletion — load and update **independently**
65	of one another on the same screen at the same time (e.g. the name can be mid-edit while the dashboard is still
66	loading). `SettingsState` is therefore one `Equatable` class with a field per concern and a `copyWith` using
67	the same `_unset` sentinel pattern `RecordsLoaded` already establishes for nullable fields that must be
68	explicitly clearable — the same shape, scaled to more independent regions, not a new pattern.
69	
70	## R5 — Display-name caching: new, settings-owned local cache; biometric state: no new cache at all
71	
72	Spec.md's "Account Profile" Key Entity requires treating "the most recent successful write... as the locally
73	held source of truth," including biometricEnabled, "defaulting sensibly... for an account that has never had
74	a successful write." Splitting this per field is simpler and more correct than a single shared cache:
75	
76	- **`displayName`** has no on-device mirror anywhere else in the app — RF03 never writes it. A new
77	  `AccountProfileLocalCache` (`features/settings/data/`, Keychain-backed via `flutter_secure_storage`, same
78	  pattern as `VaultSecureStorage`/`EntriesLocalCache`) persists only the name this unit's own successful
79	  `PATCH` last confirmed. `AccountProfile.defaultDisplayNameFromEmail(email)` (see R13) supplies the sensible
80	  default when the cache is empty.
81	- **`biometricEnabled`** already has an authoritative, always-correct on-device mirror:
82	  `VaultRepository.isBiometricPreferenceEnabled()` (`VaultSecureStorage`), written synchronously during RF03's
83	  first-time setup regardless of whether that setup's own backend write succeeded (RF03 FR-014, local-first).
84	  Reading the toggle's initial state from there is *more* correct than inventing a second, settings-owned
85	  cache that RF03's write path would have to be taught to also populate — it is already "the most recent
86	  successful write" in the sense that matters (what the device itself currently enforces). No vault file needs
87	  to change for this unit to read it.
88	
89	## R6 — Settings' own biometric-toggle write path: await + revert, reusing RF03's repository as-is
90	
91	FR-014 ("the toggle MUST revert... rather than appearing to succeed") is the opposite contract from RF03's
92	existing `SaveBiometricsPreferenceUseCase` (`vault/domain/usecases/`), which is deliberately fire-and-forget
93	("always completes regardless of outcome" — RF03 research.md R6, first-time setup must never block on the
94	network). Rather than changing that usecase's contract (and risking RF03's own already-shipped behavior), this
95	unit adds a new, settings-owned usecase, `SaveSettingsBiometricPreferenceUseCase`
96	(`features/settings/domain/usecases/`), that:
97	1. calls `BiometricsPreferenceRepository.save(enabled)` (vault's existing, single-field repository — reused
98	   verbatim, not re-implemented — "continuing the account-settings read/write path RF03 already established
99	   for this same flag," FR-013's own wording) and *awaits* the `Either`;
100	2. on `Right`: calls `VaultRepository.setBiometricPreferenceLocally(enabled)` so the device's own unlock gate
101	   and Settings' displayed value move together;
102	3. on `Left`: returns the failure untouched — the local mirror is never written, so a later app relock still
103	   gates on the last-confirmed value, and `SettingsBloc` reverts the toggle's optimistic UI flip.
104	
105	`BiometricsPreferenceRepository`/`BiometricsPreferenceRemoteDataSource` (vault/) are unmodified; this is a new
106	caller, not a new implementation.
107	
108	## R7 — Display-name write path: new, narrow `AccountProfileRepository`
109	
110	Mirrors `BiometricsPreferenceRepository`'s own documented reasoning ("deliberately narrow... rather than a
111	general-purpose account-settings repository"). A new `AccountSettingsRemoteDataSource.updateDisplayName()`
112	(`features/settings/data/`) sends `PATCH account-settings-update` with `{"displayName": ...}` only (never
113	`persona`, FR-015). `AccountProfileRepositoryImpl.updateDisplayName()` persists the confirmed name into
114	`AccountProfileLocalCache` before returning `Right` (FR-010, SC-005), and never touches `biometricEnabled` or
115	`persona` — a client-side-only `AccountProfile` validation (1–80 chars, FR-011) runs in the bloc before any
116	repository call, so an invalid name never reaches the network.
117	
118	## R8 — Logout extends the existing `auth/` feature; account deletion is new, inside `settings/`
119	
120	`POST /auth/logout` (`auth-logout`) is an auth-domain concern indistinguishable in shape from
121	`auth-signup`/`auth-login`, already owned by `AuthRepository`/`AuthRemoteDataSource`/`AuthRepositoryImpl`
122	(`features/auth/`) — this unit adds one method, `logout()`, to all three, the same "extend an earlier unit's
123	file in place" precedent RF05 already set on `records_page.dart`. `DELETE /account` (`account-delete`) is new
124	and squarely RF09/RNF05-owned, so it gets its own repository inside `features/settings/`
125	(`AccountDeletionRepository`/`AccountDeletionRemoteDataSource`/`AccountDeletionRepositoryImpl`), sending the
126	backend-required `{"confirmation": "DELETE"}` body the user never types (FR-018).
127	
128	## R9 — What gets cleared locally: logout is narrower than account deletion, by FR text
129	
130	FR-016 (Sair): "clear the local session and any cached account/profile state." FR-019 (Apagar conta): "clear
131	all local session, cached account/profile, **and any other locally held user data**." The extra clause in
132	FR-019 is read literally as a scope difference, not a wording accident — deleting the account is the LGPD hard
133	-delete path and must leave nothing recoverable; logging out from an account that still exists has no such
134	requirement. Concretely:
135	
136	- **Both** actions clear `SessionRepository` (`SecureTokenStorage`'s 4 keys) and `AccountProfileLocalCache`
137	  (the cached display name) — the two "session" and "cached account/profile" nouns FR-016 itself names.
138	- **Only account deletion** additionally clears `EntriesLocalCache`/`ChatLocalCache` (both extended in place
139	  with a new `clear()` method, R14) and their owning repositories' in-memory mirrors (`EntriesRepository`/
140	  `ChatRepository` gain a `clearLocalData()` method each) — "any other locally held user data," FR-019.
141	- **Neither** action touches `VaultSecureStorage` (the device PIN hash or the biometrics-preference mirror) —
142	  see R10, this is deliberate and matches the prototype's own simulated destination.
143	
144	## R10 — Post-logout/deletion destination: computed from `hasPinConfigured()`, reusing existing routes only
145	
146	The prototype extract states both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to "Tela 0.1 — Biometria" — the same
147	destination (`prototype-extract.md` §1, §4.2). Spec.md's own Assumption resolves "the app's authentication
148	entry point" as "whatever F000/RF03 already resolve that case to (the vault screen if a device-level
149	PIN/biometric flow applies with no session, falling through to login otherwise) rather than building a
150	separate destination." The literal, minimal reading of that: `SettingsBloc` checks
151	`VaultRepository.hasPinConfigured()` after the session/profile clear and resolves to `AppRoutes.vault` (if
152	true) or `AppRoutes.login` (if false) — the same two routes `SplashPage` already builds its own routing
153	decision from, never a new route or screen. `SettingsPage` performs `context.go()` (not `push`) on the
154	resulting terminal state, discarding the whole Home/Settings back-stack, so there is no way to navigate back
155	into a signed-out Settings screen. Whatever happens *after* a vault unlock with no stored session (i.e.
156	arriving at Home with nothing to authenticate it) is explicitly left to the already-existing, already-built
157	expired-session machinery named in spec.md's own Edge Cases ("the existing expired-session handling —
158	established by F000, continued by RF07 — takes over exactly as it does elsewhere") — this unit does not add a
159	second mechanism for that.
160	
161	## R11 — Reauth wiring reuses the established `reauthRequired` stream pattern
162	
163	`SettingsBloc` exposes a broadcast `Stream<void> get reauthRequired`, fired whenever a repository call's single
164	silent-refresh retry (the same `_retryAfterSilentRefresh` shape `EntriesRepositoryImpl`/`ChatRepositoryImpl`
165	already use) still comes back `AuthExpiredFailure`. `SettingsPage` subscribes in `initState` and forwards to
166	`context.read<SessionBloc>().add(const AuthExpiredDetected())` — verbatim the same wiring `RecordsPage`/
167	`AppDrawer`/`ExportSheet` already each do for their own blocs (research.md precedent, RF06/RF07/RF05). The
168	already-wired, app-level `BlocListener<SessionBloc>` in `main.dart` is what actually raises the overlay; this
169	unit adds no second overlay-raising mechanism.
170	
171	## R12 — Double-tap guards are in-flight booleans on `SettingsState`, not a separate mechanism
172	
173	FR-022 is satisfied the same way `ExportBloc`'s own tap-guard already is: `isSigningOut`/`isDeletingAccount`
174	booleans on `SettingsState`, checked at the top of the corresponding event handler before any repository call
175	is made — a second tap while one is `true` is a no-op. No new synchronization primitive, no shared mutable
176	flag outside the bloc's own state.
177	
178	## R13 — `AccountProfile`'s email-derived default is extracted from `AppDrawer`, not duplicated
179	
180	`app_drawer.dart`'s `_displayNameFromEmail`/`_initialsFromEmail`/`_emailNameWords` (private, email-local-part
181	-splitting functions) carry their own comment: *"A real display name belongs to the Configurações unit... this
182	is a stand-in until that unit wires one in."* This unit is that unit. The three functions move, unchanged in
183	behavior, into `features/settings/domain/entities/account_profile.dart` as `AccountProfile`'s static
184	`defaultDisplayNameFromEmail(email)` and an `initials` getter (now deriving initials from whatever
185	`displayName` is actually showing — the cached/edited name once one exists, the email-derived default
186	otherwise — rather than always re-deriving from the email). `AppDrawer` is extended in place to read
187	`AccountProfileRepository.readCachedDisplayName()` (`settings/domain/`, falling back to the same default)
188	instead of always showing the email-derived stand-in, and to call the shared `AccountProfile.initials` instead
189	of its own now-deleted private copies — the drawer and Settings show the same name from the same source, by
190	construction. This is a genuinely cross-feature domain import (`features/home/presentation/` →
191	`features/settings/domain/`), the same shape `ChatBloc`'s import of
192	`entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase.dart` already establishes as acceptable under Principle V —
193	never a reach into `settings/data/`'s `AccountProfileLocalCache` directly.
194	
195	## R14 — New design tokens: avatar size + chart geometry only; colors fully reused
196	
197	`DesignTokens`' panel has no numeric bar-chart dimensions and no 52px avatar size (only `sizeAvatarMenu = 40`).
198	Four new, narrowly-scoped size tokens are added — `sizeAvatarSettings` (52, prototype-extract.md §6's own
199	"52px in Configurações"), `sizeChartBarMaxHeight`, `sizeChartBarWidth`, `sizeChartBarGap` — plus one new color,
200	`colorChartPlaceholder`, for the "light-gray placeholder chart icon" the zero-entries state needs (no existing
201	token is documented as light-gray; `colorBorder` (`#E1DACB`) is the closest existing neutral and is reused as
202	this new token's value rather than inventing an unrelated hex, keeping the palette internally consistent). The
203	"ochre" bar color is `DesignTokens.colorAccent` verbatim — already documented in the tokens panel and already
204	used for exactly this "CTA, insight, saved bookmark" register; the "10-bar ochre chart" wording in
205	prototype-extract.md §2.6 names the existing accent color, not a new one.
206	
207	## R15 — Post-reauth refresh on Settings: `RouteAware`, reusing the existing `chatRouteObserver`
208	
209	Spec.md's Edge Case for Settings explicitly differs from Records'/Chat's own expired-session handling: "the
210	dashboard, profile, and any in-progress edit [are] reasonably re-requested, not silently lost" — "re-requested"
211	is a stronger guarantee than Records' own (which only promises no lost scroll position, not a refetch).
212	Because `showSessionExpiredOverlay` pushes the reauth `LoginSignupPage` via `rootNavigatorKey` — the exact
213	`Navigator` `GoRouter` itself renders into (`app_router.dart`'s own `navigatorKey: rootNavigatorKey`) — and
214	`context.push(AppRoutes.settings)` (how `AppDrawer` already reaches Settings) stacks `SettingsPage` on that
215	same navigator, the already-registered `chatRouteObserver` (`app_router.dart`, currently subscribed to only by
216	`HomeChatShellPage` to detect being covered) observes a Settings-covering reauth push/pop too. `SettingsPage`'s
217	`State` becomes `RouteAware`, subscribes to the same `chatRouteObserver` instance in `didChangeDependencies()`
218	(mirroring `HomeChatShellPage`'s own subscribe/unsubscribe shape exactly), and dispatches a fresh
219	`SettingsOpened` from `didPopNext()` — the moment the reauth page above it is popped and Settings becomes the
220	topmost route again. This is a second subscriber to an existing, already-general-purpose `RouteObserver`, not
221	a second observer registered on `GoRouter` itself.
222	
223	## R16 — RNF09's project-wide write-endpoint tally: this unit's contribution, not a final count
224	
225	Every prior unit's plan reports its own new write-endpoint coverage without asserting the project-wide
226	fraction's exact final value (009's research.md R13 explicitly declines to, for the same reason — later units'
227	own contributions aren't yet verifiable from an earlier plan). This unit adds full timeout/malformed/
228	no-connection coverage for two **new** write endpoints — `account-delete` (`DELETE`, contracts/
229	account-deletion-repository.md) and `auth-logout` (`POST`, empty body, contracts/account-session-actions.md)
230	— and extends `account-settings-update`'s existing coverage (already contributed by RF03) with a second,
231	independently-sent field (`displayName`, contracts/account-profile-repository.md). `dashboard-aggregate-get`/
232	`dashboard-narrative-get` are `GET`s, outside RNF09's "write endpoint" tally, but are still fully
233	`Either`-typed and covered by contracts/dashboard-repository.md's own scenario table regardless, same as every
234	prior unit's read endpoints.
235

(FR-003/FR-004/FR-005) — the bloc inspects the already-resolved aggregate's own total, never a second network
round-trip to "find out" the count. Both calls send the single fixed query parameter `period=all` (spec.md
Assumption "Dashboard period") — no period parameter is ever user-controlled in this unit.

## R2 — Ten-bar bucketing is a pure, total function over `(buckets, today)`

Spec.md's Clarification/Assumption fixes the algorithm in words ("divide the account's full date range — date
of the first entry through today — into ten roughly-equal time slices and sum the per-date counts falling
within each slice"); this unit only has to fix the exact integer arithmetic so the function is deterministic
and testable:

```
List<int> tenBars(List<AggregateBucket> buckets, DateTime today) {
  if (buckets.isEmpty) return List.filled(10, 0);
  final start = buckets.map((b) => b.date).reduce((a, b) => a.isBefore(b) ? a : b);
  final totalDaySpan = today.difference(start).inDays; // >= 0; both date-only (UTC midnight)
  final bars = List.filled(10, 0);
  if (totalDaySpan == 0) {
    // Every entry happened "today" relative to the account's own first entry
    // (e.g. 2 entries created minutes apart) — a single-day range cannot be
    // divided into 10 meaningful slices, so the whole total lands in the
    // last bar rather than every bar collapsing onto index 0.
    bars[9] = buckets.fold(0, (sum, b) => sum + b.count);
    return bars;
  }
  for (final bucket in buckets) {
    final daysSinceStart = bucket.date.difference(start).inDays;
    final index = (daysSinceStart * 10) ~/ (totalDaySpan + 1);
    bars[index.clamp(0, 9)] += bucket.count;
  }
  return bars;
}
```
`totalDaySpan + 1` (not `totalDaySpan`) is the slice divisor so the very last day (`daysSinceStart ==
totalDaySpan`) still lands inside bar index 9, not spilling past it. This function is pure (no `DateTime.now()`
inside it — the caller passes `today`), lives in `domain/`, and is the one piece of this unit's logic RNF07
most needs to hit ≥80% on, mirroring `DateRangeFilter`/`SyncBadgeState`'s existing pure-derivation shape.

## R3 — No new charting dependency

The chart is always exactly 10 bars with no interaction (no tooltip, no zoom, no legend) — a `Row` of 10
`Container`s whose heights are `count / maxBarCount * DesignTokens.sizeChartBarMaxHeight` (clamped to a
minimum visible sliver for a non-zero, sub-pixel bar) already renders this losslessly with widgets the app
already depends on. Adding `fl_chart`/`syncfusion_flutter_charts`/etc. for 10 static bars would be the first
charting dependency in the app for a shape plain `Flutter` already draws — rejected (Complexity Tracking).
Principle II's "chart package" being a free/open choice means "free to add one if needed," not "must add one."

## R4 — `SettingsState` is one flat composite state, not a sealed per-mode hierarchy

Unlike `VaultBloc` (a strictly sequential state machine — PIN setup, then biometric prompt, then unlock) or
`ExportBloc` (one sheet, one job, mutually exclusive terminal states), Settings' four concerns — dashboard,
narrative, profile/name-edit, biometric toggle, sign-out, account-deletion — load and update **independently**
of one another on the same screen at the same time (e.g. the name can be mid-edit while the dashboard is still
loading). `SettingsState` is therefore one `Equatable` class with a field per concern and a `copyWith` using
the same `_unset` sentinel pattern `RecordsLoaded` already establishes for nullable fields that must be
explicitly clearable — the same shape, scaled to more independent regions, not a new pattern.

## R5 — Display-name caching: new, settings-owned local cache; biometric state: no new cache at all

Spec.md's "Account Profile" Key Entity requires treating "the most recent successful write... as the locally
held source of truth," including biometricEnabled, "defaulting sensibly... for an account that has never had
a successful write." Splitting this per field is simpler and more correct than a single shared cache:

- **`displayName`** has no on-device mirror anywhere else in the app — RF03 never writes it. A new
  `AccountProfileLocalCache` (`features/settings/data/`, Keychain-backed via `flutter_secure_storage`, same
  pattern as `VaultSecureStorage`/`EntriesLocalCache`) persists only the name this unit's own successful
  `PATCH` last confirmed. `AccountProfile.defaultDisplayNameFromEmail(email)` (see R13) supplies the sensible
  default when the cache is empty.
- **`biometricEnabled`** already has an authoritative, always-correct on-device mirror:
  `VaultRepository.isBiometricPreferenceEnabled()` (`VaultSecureStorage`), written synchronously during RF03's
  first-time setup regardless of whether that setup's own backend write succeeded (RF03 FR-014, local-first).
  Reading the toggle's initial state from there is *more* correct than inventing a second, settings-owned
  cache that RF03's write path would have to be taught to also populate — it is already "the most recent
  successful write" in the sense that matters (what the device itself currently enforces). No vault file needs
  to change for this unit to read it.

## R6 — Settings' own biometric-toggle write path: await + revert, reusing RF03's repository as-is

FR-014 ("the toggle MUST revert... rather than appearing to succeed") is the opposite contract from RF03's
existing `SaveBiometricsPreferenceUseCase` (`vault/domain/usecases/`), which is deliberately fire-and-forget
("always completes regardless of outcome" — RF03 research.md R6, first-time setup must never block on the
network). Rather than changing that usecase's contract (and risking RF03's own already-shipped behavior), this
unit adds a new, settings-owned usecase, `SaveSettingsBiometricPreferenceUseCase`
(`features/settings/domain/usecases/`), that:
1. calls `BiometricsPreferenceRepository.save(enabled)` (vault's existing, single-field repository — reused
   verbatim, not re-implemented — "continuing the account-settings read/write path RF03 already established
   for this same flag," FR-013's own wording) and *awaits* the `Either`;
2. on `Right`: calls `VaultRepository.setBiometricPreferenceLocally(enabled)` so the device's own unlock gate
   and Settings' displayed value move together;
3. on `Left`: returns the failure untouched — the local mirror is never written, so a later app relock still
   gates on the last-confirmed value, and `SettingsBloc` reverts the toggle's optimistic UI flip.

`BiometricsPreferenceRepository`/`BiometricsPreferenceRemoteDataSource` (vault/) are unmodified; this is a new
caller, not a new implementation.

## R7 — Display-name write path: new, narrow `AccountProfileRepository`

Mirrors `BiometricsPreferenceRepository`'s own documented reasoning ("deliberately narrow... rather than a
general-purpose account-settings repository"). A new `AccountSettingsRemoteDataSource.updateDisplayName()`
(`features/settings/data/`) sends `PATCH account-settings-update` with `{"displayName": ...}` only (never
`persona`, FR-015). `AccountProfileRepositoryImpl.updateDisplayName()` persists the confirmed name into
`AccountProfileLocalCache` before returning `Right` (FR-010, SC-005), and never touches `biometricEnabled` or
`persona` — a client-side-only `AccountProfile` validation (1–80 chars, FR-011) runs in the bloc before any
repository call, so an invalid name never reaches the network.

## R8 — Logout extends the existing `auth/` feature; account deletion is new, inside `settings/`

`POST /auth/logout` (`auth-logout`) is an auth-domain concern indistinguishable in shape from
`auth-signup`/`auth-login`, already owned by `AuthRepository`/`AuthRemoteDataSource`/`AuthRepositoryImpl`
(`features/auth/`) — this unit adds one method, `logout()`, to all three, the same "extend an earlier unit's
file in place" precedent RF05 already set on `records_page.dart`. `DELETE /account` (`account-delete`) is new
and squarely RF09/RNF05-owned, so it gets its own repository inside `features/settings/`
(`AccountDeletionRepository`/`AccountDeletionRemoteDataSource`/`AccountDeletionRepositoryImpl`), sending the
backend-required `{"confirmation": "DELETE"}` body the user never types (FR-018).

## R9 — What gets cleared locally: logout is narrower than account deletion, by FR text

FR-016 (Sair): "clear the local session and any cached account/profile state." FR-019 (Apagar conta): "clear
all local session, cached account/profile, **and any other locally held user data**." The extra clause in
FR-019 is read literally as a scope difference, not a wording accident — deleting the account is the LGPD hard
-delete path and must leave nothing recoverable; logging out from an account that still exists has no such
requirement. Concretely:

- **Both** actions clear `SessionRepository` (`SecureTokenStorage`'s 4 keys) and `AccountProfileLocalCache`
  (the cached display name) — the two "session" and "cached account/profile" nouns FR-016 itself names.
- **Only account deletion** additionally clears `EntriesLocalCache`/`ChatLocalCache` (both extended in place
  with a new `clear()` method, R14) and their owning repositories' in-memory mirrors (`EntriesRepository`/
  `ChatRepository` gain a `clearLocalData()` method each) — "any other locally held user data," FR-019.
- **Neither** action touches `VaultSecureStorage` (the device PIN hash or the biometrics-preference mirror) —
  see R10, this is deliberate and matches the prototype's own simulated destination.

## R10 — Post-logout/deletion destination: computed from `hasPinConfigured()`, reusing existing routes only

The prototype extract states both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to "Tela 0.1 — Biometria" — the same
destination (`prototype-extract.md` §1, §4.2). Spec.md's own Assumption resolves "the app's authentication
entry point" as "whatever F000/RF03 already resolve that case to (the vault screen if a device-level
PIN/biometric flow applies with no session, falling through to login otherwise) rather than building a
separate destination." The literal, minimal reading of that: `SettingsBloc` checks
`VaultRepository.hasPinConfigured()` after the session/profile clear and resolves to `AppRoutes.vault` (if
true) or `AppRoutes.login` (if false) — the same two routes `SplashPage` already builds its own routing
decision from, never a new route or screen. `SettingsPage` performs `context.go()` (not `push`) on the
resulting terminal state, discarding the whole Home/Settings back-stack, so there is no way to navigate back
into a signed-out Settings screen. Whatever happens *after* a vault unlock with no stored session (i.e.
arriving at Home with nothing to authenticate it) is explicitly left to the already-existing, already-built
expired-session machinery named in spec.md's own Edge Cases ("the existing expired-session handling —
established by F000, continued by RF07 — takes over exactly as it does elsewhere") — this unit does not add a
second mechanism for that.

## R11 — Reauth wiring reuses the established `reauthRequired` stream pattern

`SettingsBloc` exposes a broadcast `Stream<void> get reauthRequired`, fired whenever a repository call's single
silent-refresh retry (the same `_retryAfterSilentRefresh` shape `EntriesRepositoryImpl`/`ChatRepositoryImpl`
already use) still comes back `AuthExpiredFailure`. `SettingsPage` subscribes in `initState` and forwards to
`context.read<SessionBloc>().add(const AuthExpiredDetected())` — verbatim the same wiring `RecordsPage`/
`AppDrawer`/`ExportSheet` already each do for their own blocs (research.md precedent, RF06/RF07/RF05). The
already-wired, app-level `BlocListener<SessionBloc>` in `main.dart` is what actually raises the overlay; this
unit adds no second overlay-raising mechanism.

## R12 — Double-tap guards are in-flight booleans on `SettingsState`, not a separate mechanism

FR-022 is satisfied the same way `ExportBloc`'s own tap-guard already is: `isSigningOut`/`isDeletingAccount`
booleans on `SettingsState`, checked at the top of the corresponding event handler before any repository call
is made — a second tap while one is `true` is a no-op. No new synchronization primitive, no shared mutable
flag outside the bloc's own state.

## R13 — `AccountProfile`'s email-derived default is extracted from `AppDrawer`, not duplicated

`app_drawer.dart`'s `_displayNameFromEmail`/`_initialsFromEmail`/`_emailNameWords` (private, email-local-part
-splitting functions) carry their own comment: *"A real display name belongs to the Configurações unit... this
is a stand-in until that unit wires one in."* This unit is that unit. The three functions move, unchanged in
behavior, into `features/settings/domain/entities/account_profile.dart` as `AccountProfile`'s static
`defaultDisplayNameFromEmail(email)` and an `initials` getter (now deriving initials from whatever
`displayName` is actually showing — the cached/edited name once one exists, the email-derived default
otherwise — rather than always re-deriving from the email). `AppDrawer` is extended in place to read
`AccountProfileRepository.readCachedDisplayName()` (`settings/domain/`, falling back to the same default)
instead of always showing the email-derived stand-in, and to call the shared `AccountProfile.initials` instead
of its own now-deleted private copies — the drawer and Settings show the same name from the same source, by
construction. This is a genuinely cross-feature domain import (`features/home/presentation/` →
`features/settings/domain/`), the same shape `ChatBloc`'s import of
`entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase.dart` already establishes as acceptable under Principle V —
never a reach into `settings/data/`'s `AccountProfileLocalCache` directly.

## R14 — New design tokens: avatar size + chart geometry only; colors fully reused

`DesignTokens`' panel has no numeric bar-chart dimensions and no 52px avatar size (only `sizeAvatarMenu = 40`).
Four new, narrowly-scoped size tokens are added — `sizeAvatarSettings` (52, prototype-extract.md §6's own
"52px in Configurações"), `sizeChartBarMaxHeight`, `sizeChartBarWidth`, `sizeChartBarGap` — plus one new color,
`colorChartPlaceholder`, for the "light-gray placeholder chart icon" the zero-entries state needs (no existing
token is documented as light-gray; `colorBorder` (`#E1DACB`) is the closest existing neutral and is reused as
this new token's value rather than inventing an unrelated hex, keeping the palette internally consistent). The
"ochre" bar color is `DesignTokens.colorAccent` verbatim — already documented in the tokens panel and already
used for exactly this "CTA, insight, saved bookmark" register; the "10-bar ochre chart" wording in
prototype-extract.md §2.6 names the existing accent color, not a new one.

## R15 — Post-reauth refresh on Settings: `RouteAware`, reusing the existing `chatRouteObserver`

Spec.md's Edge Case for Settings explicitly differs from Records'/Chat's own expired-session handling: "the
dashboard, profile, and any in-progress edit [are] reasonably re-requested, not silently lost" — "re-requested"
is a stronger guarantee than Records' own (which only promises no lost scroll position, not a refetch).
Because `showSessionExpiredOverlay` pushes the reauth `LoginSignupPage` via `rootNavigatorKey` — the exact
`Navigator` `GoRouter` itself renders into (`app_router.dart`'s own `navigatorKey: rootNavigatorKey`) — and
`context.push(AppRoutes.settings)` (how `AppDrawer` already reaches Settings) stacks `SettingsPage` on that
same navigator, the already-registered `chatRouteObserver` (`app_router.dart`, currently subscribed to only by
`HomeChatShellPage` to detect being covered) observes a Settings-covering reauth push/pop too. `SettingsPage`'s
`State` becomes `RouteAware`, subscribes to the same `chatRouteObserver` instance in `didChangeDependencies()`
(mirroring `HomeChatShellPage`'s own subscribe/unsubscribe shape exactly), and dispatches a fresh
`SettingsOpened` from `didPopNext()` — the moment the reauth page above it is popped and Settings becomes the
topmost route again. This is a second subscriber to an existing, already-general-purpose `RouteObserver`, not
a second observer registered on `GoRouter` itself.

## R16 — RNF09's project-wide write-endpoint tally: this unit's contribution, not a final count

Every prior unit's plan reports its own new write-endpoint coverage without asserting the project-wide
fraction's exact final value (009's research.md R13 explicitly declines to, for the same reason — later units'
own contributions aren't yet verifiable from an earlier plan). This unit adds full timeout/malformed/
no-connection coverage for two **new** write endpoints — `account-delete` (`DELETE`, contracts/
account-deletion-repository.md) and `auth-logout` (`POST`, empty body, contracts/account-session-actions.md)
— and extends `account-settings-update`'s existing coverage (already contributed by RF03) with a second,
independently-sent field (`displayName`, contracts/account-profile-repository.md). `dashboard-aggregate-get`/
`dashboard-narrative-get` are `GET`s, outside RNF09's "write endpoint" tally, but are still fully
`Either`-typed and covered by contracts/dashboard-repository.md's own scenario table regardless, same as every
prior unit's read endpoints.

# Contract: `AccountDeletionRepository`

`features/settings/domain/repositories/account_deletion_repository.dart`, implemented by
`AccountDeletionRepositoryImpl` (`features/settings/data/`), backed by
`AccountDeletionRemoteDataSource` calling `account-delete` (`DELETE /account`).

```dart
abstract class AccountDeletionRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> deleteAccount();
}
```

## Behavior

Always sends `{"confirmation": "DELETE"}` — the literal value the backend requires, supplied by the app
itself (FR-018); there is no caller-supplied parameter for it, so it is structurally impossible for this
method to ever send anything else. No retry-on-`AuthExpiredFailure` here: an expired session during the
delete-confirmation dialog is exactly spec.md's own Edge Case ("the session expires while Settings is open...
a confirmation dialog open") — the existing expired-session overlay takes over and the user re-authenticates
before retrying the tap, rather than this method silently refreshing and re-sending a destructive request
behind an overlay the user hasn't acknowledged yet. A plain `AuthExpiredFailure` `Left` surfaces through
`SettingsState.deleteFailureMessage` like any other failure and also fires `reauthRequired`.

## What `SettingsBloc` does around a `Right` result (research.md R9) — not this repository's job

On `Right(unit)`: `SessionRepository.clear()`, `AccountProfileLocalCache.clearCachedDisplayName()`,
`EntriesRepository.clearLocalData()`, `ChatRepository.clearLocalData()`, then resolve
`accountDeletedDestination` via `VaultRepository.hasPinConfigured()` (research.md R10). `VaultSecureStorage`'s
PIN hash and biometrics-preference mirror are deliberately **not** touched (research.md R9/R10).

## Scenario table (RNF09 — new write endpoint)

| # | Scenario | Expected `Either` | Account state after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 200 `{data: {ok: true}}` | `Right(unit)` | Backend account gone; app clears local state (above) |
| 2 | Dio timeout | `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure)` | Untouched — dialog shows retryable error (FR-020) |
| 3 | No connection | `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure)` | Untouched |
| 4 | 200 with a malformed body (`data.ok` missing/not `true`) | `Left(ValidationFailure)` | Untouched — never reports success on an ambiguous response |
| 5 | 401 `AUTH_EXPIRED` | `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)`, `reauthRequired` fires | Untouched |

## `SettingsBloc`'s own guard around this call (FR-022)

`isDeletingAccount` is checked and set to `true` before the call; a second `DeleteAccountConfirmed` event
while it is already `true` is dropped without calling this repository a second time (research.md R12) — same
shape as the `isSigningOut` guard around `AuthRepository.logout()`.

11	```

25	set isSigningOut = true

33	wiped — avoiding a race where the app's own token is already gone when the request tries to attach it) but
34	never branched on; both `Left` and `Right` fall through to the same unconditional clear-and-navigate sequence

4	avatar's initials straight from the email (`_displayNameFromEmail`/`_initialsFromEmail`/`_emailNameWords`),
5	with a comment naming this unit as the one that wires in a real name. This unit:
6	
7	1. Deletes `_displayNameFromEmail`/`_initialsFromEmail`/`_emailNameWords` from `app_drawer.dart`.
8	2. Adds `AccountProfile.defaultDisplayNameFromEmail`/`.initials` (data-model.md) to

14	   final email = await getIt<SecureTokenStorage>().readAccountEmail();

20	   `AccountProfileLocalCache` directly — a presentation file reaching into another feature's `data/` class

9	    required VaultRepository vaultRepository,                               // vault/domain/, unmodified

15	      (failure) => Left(failure), // local mirror left untouched — next relock still gates on the old value

19	      },

28	final capability = await vaultRepository.checkBiometricCapability();
29	final visible = capability == BiometricCapability.available;         // FR-013's "hidden entirely" rule
30	final enabled = visible ? await vaultRepository.isBiometricPreferenceEnabled() : false;

# Contract: `DashboardRepository`

`features/settings/domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart`, implemented by
`DashboardRepositoryImpl` (`features/settings/data/`), backed by `DashboardRemoteDataSource` calling
`dashboard-aggregate-get` (`GET /dashboard/aggregate?period=all`) and `dashboard-narrative-get`
(`GET /dashboard/narrative?period=all`).

```dart
abstract class DashboardRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, DashboardAggregate>> fetchAggregate();
  Future<Either<Failure, DashboardNarrative>> fetchNarrative();
}
```

## Parsing

`fetchAggregate()` decodes `data.buckets[]` (`date`, `count`, `sources.{manual,audio,photo,chat}`) and
`data.totals` (`count`, `sources`) per `openapi.yaml`'s schema (both always present, even for a zero-entry
account — "always 200" per the contract's own summary line). `fetchNarrative()` decodes `data.text`/
`data.generatedAt`. A missing/mistyped required field on either call is a `ValidationFailure` (`TypeError`
caught, never thrown past this boundary — same pattern as `SessionRepositoryImpl._assembleFromCheckSession`).

## Retry-once-on-expiry

Both methods follow `EntriesRepositoryImpl._retryAfterSilentRefresh`'s exact shape: on `AuthExpiredFailure`,
call `SessionRepository.refresh()` once; on its own failure, return
`Left(AuthExpiredFailure(message: 'Session could not be renewed'))` (no second refresh attempt); on success,
retry the original call exactly once more and return whatever it resolves to.

## Scenario table (RNF09 — `fetchAggregate`/`fetchNarrative` are `GET`s, outside the write-endpoint tally,
but still fully `Either`-typed and tested)

| # | Scenario | Expected `Either` |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 200, zero-entry account (`buckets: []`, `totals.count: 0`) | `Right(DashboardAggregate)` with an empty bucket list — never a `Left` |
| 2 | 200, well-formed non-empty payload | `Right(DashboardAggregate)` / `Right(DashboardNarrative)` |
| 3 | Dio timeout | `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure)` |
| 4 | No connection (no response) | `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure)` |
| 5 | 200 with a malformed body (`buckets` not a list / `count` missing) | `Left(ValidationFailure)` |
| 6 | 401 `AUTH_EXPIRED`, silent refresh succeeds | retried call's own result (success path re-exercises #1/#2) |
| 7 | 401 `AUTH_EXPIRED`, silent refresh itself fails | `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)`, and `SettingsBloc.reauthRequired` fires |
| 8 | `dashboard-narrative-get` returns `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | `Left(AiGenerationTimeoutFailure)` — mapped by `ErrorMapper` unchanged, surfaced by `SettingsBloc` as the "narrativa indisponível" state (FR-006), never conflated with #1's empty-history copy |

## `DashboardAggregate.tenBars()` — see data-model.md / research.md R2

Exercised directly by a domain unit test (no repository/network involved) for: empty input (10 zeros), a
single bucket on "today" (all weight in bar 9), buckets spanning exactly 10 days (one bucket per bar,
1:1), buckets spanning 100 days (several buckets folding into the same bar), and a bucket dated after `today`
(defensive — clamps to bar 9 rather than throwing or going out-of-range).

1	# Contract: `SettingsBloc`
2	
3	`features/settings/presentation/bloc/`. A `get_it` `registerFactory` (screen-scoped, same lifetime pattern as
4	`RecordsBloc`/`ExportBloc` — a fresh instance per `AppRoutes.settings` visit, never a singleton, since
5	FR-008/FR-023 require a fresh fetch on every open rather than a resumed prior state).
6	
7	## Dependencies
8	
9	`DashboardRepository`, `AccountProfileRepository`, `AccountDeletionRepository`, `AuthRepository`,
10	`SessionRepository`, `SaveSettingsBiometricPreferenceUseCase`, `VaultRepository` — no `SessionBloc` import
11	(research.md R11 keeps that cross-bloc touch at the page, not the bloc, same as `RecordsBloc`).
12	
13	## Events
14	
15	| Event | Triggers |
16	|---|---|
17	| `SettingsOpened` | Dispatched once by the route builder (`app_router.dart`), mirroring `RecordsStarted`. Kicks off: aggregate fetch → (conditionally) narrative fetch; profile load (`SessionRepository`'s cached `Account.email` + `AccountProfileRepository.readCachedDisplayName()` or the email-derived default); biometric capability + current value. |
18	| `DashboardRetryRequested` | Re-runs the aggregate (and, if it then qualifies, narrative) fetch — FR-007's retry affordance. |
19	| `NameEditStarted` | `nameEditStatus → editing`, `nameDraft` seeded with the current `displayName`. |
20	| `NameDraftChanged(String value)` | Updates `nameDraft` only — no validation yet. |
21	| `NameEditCancelled` | `nameEditStatus → viewing`, `nameDraft` discarded. |
22	| `NameEditSubmitted` | Validates `nameDraft` first (FR-011); on failure, sets `nameEditFailureMessage`, stays `editing`, **no repository call**. On pass, calls `AccountProfileRepository.updateDisplayName`; on `Right`, `displayName` updates and `nameEditStatus → viewing`; on `Left`, stays `editing` with `nameDraft` intact and a retryable message (FR-012). |
23	| `BiometricToggleChanged(bool value)` | Optimistically flips `biometricEnabled` (RNF01), calls `SaveSettingsBiometricPreferenceUseCase`; reverts + message on `Left` (contracts/biometric-preference-settings-extension.md). |
24	| `SignOutRequested` | contracts/account-session-actions.md. |
25	| `DeleteAccountDialogOpened` / `DeleteAccountDialogCancelled` | Presentation-only — toggles `deleteDialogOpen`; cancel makes **no** backend call (FR-021). |
26	| `DeleteAccountConfirmed` | contracts/account-deletion-repository.md. |
27	
28	## `reauthRequired` (research.md R11)
29	
30	```dart
31	final _reauthController = StreamController<void>.broadcast();
32	Stream<void> get reauthRequired => _reauthController.stream;
33	```
34	Fired from inside any repository-call handler whenever the result is `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)` *after* that
35	repository's own single silent-refresh retry has already been exhausted (never for the first attempt, which
36	retries silently without surfacing anything) — same trigger condition `RecordsBloc`/`ChatSessionsBloc` already
37	use for their own `reauthRequired` streams. `close()` overridden to also close `_reauthController`, mirroring
38	`RecordsBloc`.
39	
40	## `SettingsPage` wiring (`features/settings/presentation/pages/settings_page.dart`)
41	
42	```dart
43	late final StreamSubscription<void> _reauthSubscription;
44	
45	@override
46	void initState() {
47	  super.initState();
48	  _reauthSubscription = context.read<SettingsBloc>().reauthRequired.listen((_) {
49	    if (!mounted) return;
50	    context.read<SessionBloc>().add(const AuthExpiredDetected());
51	  });
52	}
53	```
54	A `BlocListener<SettingsBloc, SettingsState>` with `listenWhen` on `signedOutDestination`/
55	`accountDeletedDestination` becoming non-null performs the `context.go()` (research.md R10); a second
56	`BlocListener` (or the same one) shows the delete-confirmation `AlertDialog` while `deleteDialogOpen == true`,
57	closing it automatically on a successful deletion (the destination-change listener fires in the same frame).
58	
59	## Session-expiry mid-screen (spec.md Edge Cases; research.md R15)
60	
61	The existing `main.dart`-level `BlocListener<SessionBloc>` raises the overlay exactly as it does for every
62	other screen — no change there. Re-authenticating does **not** rebuild `SettingsPage`/`SettingsBloc` (the
63	reauth `LoginSignupPage` is pushed on top of, then popped back to, the same still-mounted `SettingsPage` —
64	`showSessionExpiredOverlay`'s own existing mechanism); instead, `SettingsPage`'s `State` is `RouteAware`,
65	subscribed to the already-existing `chatRouteObserver` (`app_router.dart`):
66	
67	```dart
68	@override
69	void didChangeDependencies() {
70	  super.didChangeDependencies();
71	  chatRouteObserver.subscribe(this, ModalRoute.of(context)! as PageRoute<void>);
72	}
73	
74	@override
75	void dispose() {
76	  chatRouteObserver.unsubscribe(this);
77	  super.dispose();
78	}
79	
80	@override
81	void didPopNext() => context.read<SettingsBloc>().add(const SettingsOpened());
82	```
83	
84	So the dashboard, profile, and biometric toggle are "reasonably re-requested" the moment the reauth page above
85	Settings is popped — matching spec.md's own wording, which is deliberately stronger here than Records'/Chat's
86	"preserve state, don't necessarily refetch" handling of the same overlay. An in-progress name edit
87	(`nameEditStatus == editing`, `nameDraft` holding unsaved text) is **not** reset by this `SettingsOpened`
88	re-dispatch — the handler only refills `dashboardStatus`/`aggregate`/`narrativeStatus`/`biometricEnabled`/
89	`displayName` (the latter only when not currently being edited), leaving `nameEditStatus`/`nameDraft` alone so
90	the user's in-progress text survives re-authentication too ("any in-progress edit... not silently lost").
91

---

description: "Task list for P-RF09 — Temporal summaries / dashboard"
---

# Tasks: P-RF09 — Temporal summaries / dashboard

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/011-settings-dashboard/`
**Prerequisites**: plan.md, spec.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md (all present)

**Tests**: Not explicitly requested in spec.md beyond the constitutional RNF07 (≥80% domain coverage) and
RNF09 (full `Either`/scenario-table coverage) gates, which this project's every prior unit has satisfied with
real `flutter_test`/`bloc_test`/`mocktail` tests (not skipped). Test tasks are therefore included, scoped
exactly to what research.md/contracts/*.md's own scenario tables enumerate — no broader test suite than that.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (US1 = dashboard, US2 = account deletion, US3 =
profile/biometric/sign-out) per spec.md's own priority order (US1 = P1, US2 = P1, US3 = P2). Foundational
work shared by all three stories (entities, the two existing-feature extensions, DI, tokens) is Phase 2.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies)
- **[Story]**: US1 (dashboard), US2 (account deletion), US3 (profile/biometric/sign-out)
- Every file path is exact; every entity/field constraint is quoted from data-model.md/contracts/*.md verbatim
  where one exists.

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter mobile project. New feature folder: `lib/features/settings/{domain,data,presentation}/`.
Tests mirror under `test/features/settings/` and `test/features/{auth,entries,chat,home}/` for the three
extended-in-place files, following this repo's existing `test/features/<feature>/<layer>/...` convention.

---

## Phase 1: Setup

No new dependencies, no new project scaffolding beyond the feature folder structure itself (plan.md Technical
Context: "No primary dependencies added"). This phase only creates the directory skeleton; no file content.

- [ ] T001 Create the empty `lib/features/settings/domain/entities/`, `lib/features/settings/domain/repositories/`,
  `lib/features/settings/domain/usecases/`, `lib/features/settings/data/`,
  `lib/features/settings/presentation/bloc/`, `lib/features/settings/presentation/widgets/` directories
  (`lib/features/settings/presentation/pages/` already exists, holding `settings_placeholder_page.dart`)

---

## Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)

**Purpose**: Domain entities, design tokens, and the three existing-feature extensions (`auth`, `entries`,
`chat`) that every user story's implementation phase depends on, plus DI wiring for everything not already
registered. **⚠️ CRITICAL**: No user story phase can be completed until this phase is done — `SettingsBloc`
(built across all three story phases) depends on every repository/usecase interface defined here.

### Design tokens

- [ ] T002 [P] Add 5 new `DesignTokens` values to `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (research.md R14,
  data-model.md): `static const double sizeAvatarSettings = 52;` (prototype-extract.md §6, "52px in
  Configurações"), `static const double sizeChartBarMaxHeight = 120;`, `static const double
  sizeChartBarWidth = 20;`, `static const double sizeChartBarGap = 6;` (Sizes section), and `static const
  Color colorChartPlaceholder = Color(0xFFE1DACB);` (Colors section — same hex as existing `colorBorder`,
  added under a new, semantically distinct name)

### Domain entities (`lib/features/settings/domain/entities/`)

- [ ] T003 [P] Create `DashboardSourceCounts` (`{manual, audio, photo, chat}`, each `int`, each "≥ 0"
  data-model.md), `AggregateBucket` (`{date: DateTime, count: int, sources: DashboardSourceCounts}` — "Parsed
  from the backend's `YYYY-MM-DD` string, date-only (no time component kept)", "count ≥ 0"), and
  `DashboardTotals` (`{count: int, sources: DashboardSourceCounts}`) in
  `lib/features/settings/domain/entities/dashboard_aggregate.dart`, each `Equatable`
- [ ] T004 [P] Create `DashboardAggregate` (`{buckets: List<AggregateBucket>, totals: DashboardTotals}`,
  `Equatable`) with the pure method `List<int> tenBars({DateTime? today})` in
  `lib/features/settings/domain/entities/dashboard_aggregate.dart`, implementing the exact algorithm from
  research.md R2: if `buckets.isEmpty` return `List.filled(10, 0)`; else compute `start` as the earliest
  bucket date, `totalDaySpan = (today ?? DateTime.now()).difference(start).inDays`; if `totalDaySpan == 0`,
  put the full summed count in `bars[9]`; otherwise for each bucket compute `index = (daysSinceStart * 10) ~/
  (totalDaySpan + 1)` clamped to `[0, 9]` and accumulate `count` into `bars[index]`
- [ ] T005 [P] Create `DashboardNarrative` (`{text: String, generatedAt: DateTime}`, `Equatable`) in
  `lib/features/settings/domain/entities/dashboard_narrative.dart`
- [ ] T006 [P] Create `AccountProfile` (`{displayName: String, email: String}`, `Equatable`) in
  `lib/features/settings/domain/entities/account_profile.dart` with: `static String
  defaultDisplayNameFromEmail(String email)` — relocate `app_drawer.dart`'s existing
  `_displayNameFromEmail`/`_emailNameWords` logic byte-for-byte unchanged (splits the email's local part on
  `._-`, title-cases each word, joins with a space; returns `email` itself if the local part is empty,
  contracts/app-drawer-display-name-extension.md point 2); `String get initials` — 1–2 uppercase letters from
  `displayName`'s whitespace-split words (first letter of the first word, plus first letter of the second
  word if one exists), `"?"` if `displayName` is empty (relocated from `_initialsFromEmail`, now deriving from
  `displayName` rather than always from email); `static bool isValidDisplayName(String value)` — `value.trim()
  .isNotEmpty && value.trim().length <= 80` (FR-011)

### Domain repository interfaces (`lib/features/settings/domain/repositories/`)

- [ ] T007 [P] Create `DashboardRepository` abstract class in
  `lib/features/settings/domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart`: `Future<Either<Failure,
  DashboardAggregate>> fetchAggregate();` and `Future<Either<Failure, DashboardNarrative>> fetchNarrative();`
  (contracts/dashboard-repository.md)
- [ ] T008 [P] Create `AccountProfileRepository` abstract class in
  `lib/features/settings/domain/repositories/account_profile_repository.dart`: `Future<String?>
  readCachedDisplayName();`, `Future<Either<Failure, String>> updateDisplayName(String name);`,
  `Future<void> clearCachedDisplayName();` (contracts/account-profile-repository.md)
- [ ] T009 [P] Create `AccountDeletionRepository` abstract class in
  `lib/features/settings/domain/repositories/account_deletion_repository.dart`: `Future<Either<Failure,
  Unit>> deleteAccount();` (contracts/account-deletion-repository.md)

### Domain usecase

- [ ] T010 [US3-shared] Create `SaveSettingsBiometricPreferenceUseCase` in
  `lib/features/settings/domain/usecases/save_settings_biometric_preference_usecase.dart`, depending on
  `BiometricsPreferenceRepository` and `VaultRepository` (both `vault/domain/`, unmodified): `Future<Either<
  Failure, void>> call(bool enabled)` awaits `_biometricsPreferenceRepository.save(enabled)`; on `Left`,
  returns the failure untouched (local mirror left alone); on `Right`, calls
  `_vaultRepository.setBiometricPreferenceLocally(enabled)` then returns `const Right(null)`
  (contracts/biometric-preference-settings-extension.md)

### Existing-feature extensions (`auth`, `entries`, `chat`) — additive methods only

- [ ] T011 [P] Add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> logout();` to `AuthRepository` abstract class in
  `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart`
- [ ] T012 Add `Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> logout()` to `AuthRemoteDataSource`
  (`lib/features/auth/data/auth_remote_data_source.dart`), calling `auth-logout` (`POST /auth/logout`,
  `bearerAuth`, empty body), returning `Right(unit)` on any 200 regardless of the response's `ok` value
  (contracts/account-session-actions.md — depends on T011)
- [ ] T013 Implement `logout()` in `AuthRepositoryImpl`
  (`lib/features/auth/data/auth_repository_impl.dart`) delegating to `AuthRemoteDataSource.logout()`,
  **without** calling `SecureTokenStorage`/`SessionRepository.clear()` itself (that stays `SettingsBloc`'s
  job per contracts/account-session-actions.md — depends on T011, T012)
- [ ] T014 [P] Add `Future<void> clear();` to `EntriesLocalCache`
  (`lib/features/entries/data/entries_local_cache.dart`), deleting every key it owns
- [ ] T015 [P] Add `Future<void> clearLocalData();` to `EntriesRepository` abstract class
  (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)
- [ ] T016 Implement `clearLocalData()` in `EntriesRepositoryImpl`
  (`lib/features/entries/data/entries_repository_impl.dart`) wiping its in-memory mirror and calling
  `EntriesLocalCache.clear()` (depends on T014, T015)
- [ ] T017 [P] Add `Future<void> clear();` to `ChatLocalCache` (`lib/features/chat/data/chat_local_cache.dart`),
  deleting every key it owns
- [ ] T018 [P] Add `Future<void> clearLocalData();` to `ChatRepository` abstract class
  (`lib/features/chat/domain/repositories/chat_repository.dart`)
- [ ] T019 Implement `clearLocalData()` in `ChatRepositoryImpl`
  (`lib/features/chat/data/chat_repository_impl.dart`) wiping its in-memory mirror and calling
  `ChatLocalCache.clear()` (depends on T017, T018)

### Foundational tests (structural + pure-domain, no I/O)

- [ ] T020 [P] Unit tests for `DashboardAggregate.tenBars()` in
  `test/features/settings/domain/entities/dashboard_aggregate_test.dart` covering exactly the five cases
  contracts/dashboard-repository.md lists: empty input → 10 zeros; a single bucket dated "today" → all
  weight in bar index 9; buckets spanning exactly 10 days → one bucket per bar, 1:1; buckets spanning 100
  days → several buckets folding into the same bar; a bucket dated after `today` → clamps to bar 9 rather
  than throwing or indexing out of range
- [ ] T021 [P] Unit tests for `AccountProfile` in
  `test/features/settings/domain/entities/account_profile_test.dart` covering
  `defaultDisplayNameFromEmail` (including the empty-local-part fallback to the email itself), `initials`
  (two-word name, one-word name, empty `displayName` → `"?"`), and `isValidDisplayName` (empty string →
  `false`, exactly 80 chars → `true`, 81 chars → `false`, whitespace-only → `false`)
- [ ] T022 Run `flutter test test/architecture/domain_purity_test.dart
  test/architecture/no_bloc_imports_bloc_test.dart` and confirm both still pass with `features/settings/`
  present (quickstart.md Edge Cases) — no code change expected, this task is a verification gate

**Checkpoint**: Foundation ready — domain entities, repository interfaces, the biometric usecase, and all
three existing-feature extensions exist and are tested. User story phases can now proceed.

---

## Phase 3: User Story 1 - Seeing your evolution dashboard (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Settings shows the ten-bar evolution chart and AI narrative, correctly distinguishing the
zero/one/multi-entry/error states, always recomputed fresh.

**Independent Test**: Open Settings for accounts seeded with zero, one, and more-than-thirty entries; each
renders its own distinct, non-crashing state with the correct chart and narrative text (quickstart.md Story
1).

### Tests for User Story 1

- [ ] T023 [P] [US1] Test for `DashboardRemoteDataSource`/`DashboardRepositoryImpl.fetchAggregate()` in
  `test/features/settings/data/dashboard_repository_impl_test.dart` covering contracts/dashboard-repository.md's
  scenario table #1–7 for `fetchAggregate`: 200 zero-entry (`buckets: []`, `totals.count: 0`) → `Right` with
  empty bucket list; 200 well-formed non-empty → `Right`; Dio timeout → `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure)`; no
  connection → `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure)`; malformed body (`buckets` not a list / `count` missing) →
  `Left(ValidationFailure)`; 401 `AUTH_EXPIRED` + successful silent refresh → retried result; 401
  `AUTH_EXPIRED` + failed silent refresh → `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)`
- [ ] T024 [P] [US1] Test for `DashboardRepositoryImpl.fetchNarrative()` in
  `test/features/settings/data/dashboard_repository_impl_test.dart` (same file as T023) covering the same
  scenario shapes for `fetchNarrative`, plus scenario #8: `dashboard-narrative-get` returning
  `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` → `Left(AiGenerationTimeoutFailure)`

### Implementation for User Story 1

- [ ] T025 [P] [US1] Create `DashboardRemoteDataSource` in
  `lib/features/settings/data/dashboard_remote_data_source.dart` with two methods calling
  `dashboard-aggregate-get` (`GET /dashboard/aggregate?period=all`) and `dashboard-narrative-get`
  (`GET /dashboard/narrative?period=all`) via `ApiClient`, decoding `data.buckets[]`
  (`date`/`count`/`sources.{manual,audio,photo,chat}`) and `data.totals` for the aggregate, `data.text`/
  `data.generatedAt` for the narrative, per `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s schema
- [ ] T026 [US1] Implement `DashboardRepositoryImpl` in
  `lib/features/settings/data/dashboard_repository_impl.dart` implementing `DashboardRepository`, calling
  `DashboardRemoteDataSource`, catching `TypeError` on decode as `ValidationFailure` (never thrown past the
  boundary, same pattern as `SessionRepositoryImpl._assembleFromCheckSession`), and applying the
  retry-once-on-`AuthExpiredFailure` shape from `EntriesRepositoryImpl._retryAfterSilentRefresh` to both
  methods (depends on T007, T025)
- [ ] T027 [P] [US1] Create `lib/features/settings/presentation/bloc/settings_event.dart` with (at minimum
  for this phase) `SettingsOpened` and `DashboardRetryRequested` events, as `Equatable` classes
- [ ] T028 [P] [US1] Create `lib/features/settings/presentation/bloc/settings_state.dart`: one `Equatable`
  class per data-model.md's full field table — `dashboardStatus` (`DashboardStatus` enum: `loading, loaded,
  loadFailure`, default `loading`), `aggregate` (`DashboardAggregate?`, default `null`), `dashboardFailure`
  (`Failure?`, default `null`), `narrativeStatus` (`NarrativeStatus` enum: `notRequested, loading, loaded,
  unavailable`, default `notRequested`), `narrativeText` (`String?`, default `null`), `displayName`
  (`String`, default `''`), `email` (`String`, default `''`), `nameEditStatus` (`NameEditStatus` enum:
  `viewing, editing, saving, error`, default `viewing`), `nameDraft` (`String`, default `''`),
  `nameEditFailureMessage` (`String?`, default `null`), `biometricToggleVisible` (`bool`, default `false`),
  `biometricEnabled` (`bool`, default `false`), `biometricSaving` (`bool`, default `false`),
  `biometricFailureMessage` (`String?`, default `null`), `isSigningOut` (`bool`, default `false`),
  `isDeletingAccount` (`bool`, default `false`), `deleteDialogOpen` (`bool`, default `false`),
  `deleteFailureMessage` (`String?`, default `null`), `signedOutDestination` (`SettingsDestination?`:
  `vault`/`login`, default `null`), `accountDeletedDestination` (`SettingsDestination?`, default `null`) —
  with a `copyWith` using the `RecordsLoaded`-style `_unset` sentinel for every nullable field that must be
  explicitly clearable (research.md R4)
- [ ] T029 [US1] Create `lib/features/settings/presentation/bloc/settings_bloc.dart` as a `Bloc<SettingsEvent,
  SettingsState>` depending on `DashboardRepository`, `AccountProfileRepository`, `AccountDeletionRepository`,
  `AuthRepository`, `SessionRepository`, `SaveSettingsBiometricPreferenceUseCase`, `VaultRepository`
  (contracts/settings-bloc.md's Dependencies list); implement the broadcast `reauthRequired` stream
  (`StreamController<void>.broadcast()`, fired whenever a repository call's own single silent-refresh retry
  still returns `AuthExpiredFailure`), with `close()` overridden to also close it (mirroring `RecordsBloc`);

  (`dashboardStatus → loading` then `loaded`/`loadFailure`); only fetch the narrative once the aggregate
  resolves `Right` **and** `aggregate.totals.count >= 2` (`narrativeStatus` stays `notRequested` below 2,
  otherwise `loading → loaded`/`unavailable` — FR-003/004/005/006); implement `DashboardRetryRequested` as a
  re-run of the same aggregate-then-conditionally-narrative sequence (FR-007) (depends on T007, T027, T028)
- [ ] T030 [P] [US1] Create `lib/features/settings/presentation/widgets/dashboard_bar_chart.dart`: a `Row` of
  10 `Container`s (research.md R3, no charting package), each bar's height `= count / maxBarCount *
  DesignTokens.sizeChartBarMaxHeight` (clamped to a minimum visible sliver for a non-zero sub-pixel bar),
  width `DesignTokens.sizeChartBarWidth`, gap `DesignTokens.sizeChartBarGap`, fill color
  `DesignTokens.colorAccent` (ochre); also render the single-bar state (exactly one bar) when
  `tenBars()` effectively collapses to one populated index
- [ ] T031 [P] [US1] Create `lib/features/settings/presentation/widgets/dashboard_card.dart`: switches
  between the dashboard's states — `loading` (a loading indicator, satisfying RNF01's >300ms affordance
  requirement), zero-entries empty state (light-gray `DesignTokens.colorChartPlaceholder` placeholder chart
  icon + the exact text "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui", FR-003), one-entry state (single
  small bar + the exact text "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão — volte em alguns dias.", FR-004), multi-bar

  (a clear, non-crashing, retryable error state distinct from the empty state, dispatching
  `DashboardRetryRequested` on retry tap, FR-007)
- [ ] T032 [P] [US1] Create `lib/features/settings/presentation/widgets/narrative_view.dart`: renders
  `narrativeText` when `narrativeStatus == loaded`; renders a distinct "narrativa indisponível" message
  (this unit's one new authored copy string, in Portuguese, consistent with the rest of the screen's
  register) when `narrativeStatus == unavailable`; renders nothing when `notRequested` or `loading` (a
  loading affordance only, never conflated with the "indisponível" message or the zero-entries empty state —
  FR-006)
- [ ] T033 [US1] Create `lib/features/settings/presentation/pages/settings_page.dart` as a
  `StatelessWidget`/`StatefulWidget` wrapping a `BlocProvider<SettingsBloc>(create: (_) =>
  getIt<SettingsBloc>()..add(const SettingsOpened()))`, rendering `DashboardCard` and `NarrativeView` at the
  top of the screen (the other two widgets, `ProfileHeader`/`BiometricToggleRow`, are added to this same page
  in Phase 5 — this task only wires the dashboard section plus the page's basic `Scaffold`/`AppBar` shell so
  US1 is independently viewable) (depends on T029, T030, T031, T032)
- [ ] T034 [US1] Wire `AppRoutes.settings`'s route builder in `lib/core/routing/app_router.dart` to
  `SettingsPage` instead of `SettingsPlaceholderPage`, removing the now-unused

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies — can start immediately.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup. Blocks all three user story phases — every story's
  `SettingsBloc` work depends on the entities/repository interfaces/usecase/extensions defined here.
- **User Story 1 (Phase 3)**: Depends on Phase 2. Also creates the shared `settings_event.dart`/
  `settings_state.dart`/`settings_bloc.dart`/`settings_page.dart` files that Phases 4 and 5 extend in place.
- **User Story 2 (Phase 4)**: Depends on Phase 2 and on Phase 3's creation of `settings_bloc.dart`/
  `settings_page.dart` (it extends those files rather than creating new ones) — cannot start in true
  parallel with Phase 3 on those shared files, though its own new files (T038, T039, T042) can be built
  ahead of time.
- **User Story 3 (Phase 5)**: Same shared-file dependency on Phase 3 as Phase 4; independent of Phase 4's
  own new files otherwise.
- **Polish (Phase 6)**: Depends on Phases 3, 4, and 5 all being complete.

### User Story Dependencies

- **US1**: No dependency on US2/US3's own logic — the dashboard section is fully self-contained once Phase
  2 is done.
- **US2**: No functional dependency on US1 beyond sharing `settings_bloc.dart`/`settings_page.dart` as files
  (the delete flow reads no dashboard state).
- **US3**: No functional dependency on US1/US2 beyond the same shared files; profile/biometric/sign-out
  logic is independent of both.

### Within Each User Story

- Tests before implementation where both exist for the same unit of work.
- Data sources before repository impls; repository impls before bloc handlers; bloc handlers before widgets
  that dispatch their events; widgets before the page that assembles them; DI registration last (needs the
  concrete classes to exist).

### Parallel Opportunities

- All Phase 2 entity tasks (T003–T006) are `[P]` — different files, no interdependency beyond T004 extending
  the same file T003 creates (sequential within that one file, parallel with T005/T006).
- All Phase 2 repository-interface tasks (T007–T009) are `[P]`.
- The three existing-feature extension tracks (`auth`: T011→T012→T013; `entries`: T014/T015→T016; `chat`:
  T017/T018→T019) are mutually `[P]` as tracks, sequential within each track.
- T020/T021 (foundational tests) are `[P]`.
- Within US1: T023/T024 (tests, same file but independent scenario groups — write together), T025 alongside
  T027/T028 are `[P]`; T030/T031/T032 (three independent widget files) are `[P]`.
- Within US2: T036/T037 are `[P]`; T042 is `[P]` with the bloc-handler work (T041).
- Within US3: T045/T046/T047 are `[P]`; T049/T050 are `[P]`; T055/T056 are `[P]`.

Task: "Create DashboardSourceCounts/AggregateBucket/DashboardTotals in dashboard_aggregate.dart"
Task: "Create DashboardNarrative in dashboard_narrative.dart"
Task: "Create AccountProfile in account_profile.dart"

```

## Parallel Example: User Story 1

```bash

Task: "Test DashboardRepositoryImpl.fetchNarrative() scenarios"
